name: Rest Encounter
description: Random encounter table for rests (d100). The rest planner draws from it when an encounter check succeeds. The text is only for the GM: the result is whispered and never shown to the players automatically. Edit, add or reweight entries as you like.

results.name: Scavengers at the edge of the camp
results.description: Two or three desperate scavengers creep closer to steal supplies or gear. Easily scared off, but they will fight if cornered. Weapons are crude.

results.name: Vermin swarm
results.description: Rats, hive-roaches or similar pests pour through the rest area, spoil rations and bite sleepers. Nuisance more than danger; may carry disease.

results.name: Lost pilgrims or refugees
results.description: A small group of frightened civilians asks for shelter, food or protection. They may know a rumour, or they may be bait.

results.name: Patrol of the local authorities
results.description: Enforcers or militia on patrol ask who the group is and what they carry. Social test or paperwork decides whether this is trouble.

results.name: Gang members out for a fight
results.description: A street or hive gang claims this place as its own and demands a toll. Roughly equal numbers, mixed weapons.

results.name: Smugglers on their own business
results.description: Smugglers moving cargo want no witnesses. They bargain, bribe or threaten. Their cargo is contraband worth a closer look.

results.name: Wounded stranger
results.description: A badly hurt stranger stumbles into the camp. First Aid could save them. They carry something, or something follows them.

results.name: Strange noises and false alarm
results.description: Unexplained sounds from the dark. The watch is on edge; whoever keeps watch tests their nerve. In the end it may be nothing, or a scouting enemy.

results.name: Environmental hazard
results.description: A structural failure, a toxic leak or a sudden flood forces the group to move or take cover. Gear may be lost, fatigue may follow.

results.name: Theft or sabotage in the night
results.description: Something goes missing or is tampered with while the camp sleeps: ammunition, a vehicle part, a vox unit. Who had access?

results.name: Cult watchers
results.description: Followers of a forbidden cult observe the group from hiding and report to their masters. A trail leads to a hidden gathering place.

results.name: Tech-adept scouts or a malfunctioning servitor
results.description: A servitor or machine spirit acts oddly, or Mechanicus agents appear and ask uncomfortable questions about the group's equipment.

results.name: Ambush
results.description: A hostile group has tracked the characters and strikes at the weakest watch. Roll for surprise; the watch plan decides who is ready.

results.name: Warp disturbance
results.description: Dreams turn dark, animals panic, light flickers. A psyker in the camp feels the veil thin. Minor psychic phenomena are possible; the GM chooses the effect.

results.name: Hunters from the dark
results.description: Something large and predatory stalks the camp: a mutant beast, a xenos hunter or a thing from the sewers. Hard to see, hard to kill.

results.name: Major threat
results.description: A powerful enemy force or a horror arrives. The group cannot win a straight fight; escape, hiding or a bold plan are needed.
